entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an item. Order number is VF789-001.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up... I see an order for a pair of cycling shoes. To get started, can I ask what specifically is the issue with them?
Look, they're just not working for me. They're causing blisters and I can't get the cleats to feel right. I just need to know if I can get a refund.
I understand. I just need to confirm the purchase date. I see here they were delivered 13 days ago. Let me check the policy.
Is it a yes or a no? I don't have a lot of time.
Yes, it's a yes. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I can definitely process that return for you.
Great. So you're sending a label?

Correct. I've just authorized the return in our system. You will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next five minutes. Once we receive the shoes back at our warehouse, we will issue a full refund to your original payment method.
Okay, perfect. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
